The app-owned `amirahco-clarify` instructions adapt ambiguity and specification-quality practices from GitHub Spec Kit v1.2.5 at commit `4572a67fe0e72a6837e2d7bb0fda875bc41482e5`. The original MIT license is preserved in `SPEC-KIT-LICENSE.txt`.
